Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap from our side:
- Goals: explore embedding + reranking use cases and confirm latency/cost SLOs for the pilot.
- Main infra considerations: model variant options (fp16 vs 4-bit quant), expected RPS, and privacy controls for PHI.

Next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML/infra leads so we can walk through architecture, performance expectations, and a proposed rollout plan. Proposed agenda (draft):
1) 10 min intros & goals
2) 20 min architecture + infra constraints (your team)
3) 25 min Redwood runtime + kernel/quantization options (engineering)
4) 15 min integration plan, security & compliance notes
5) 10 min Q&A / next steps

Proposed time slots (PST):
- Tue Jan 12, 10:00–11:30
- Tue Jan 12, 14:00–15:30
- Wed Jan 13, 09:00–10:30

Please let me know which slot works best and who from your team will attend (ML lead, infra/ops, security). I attached a short agenda and one-pager on SLAs to this email.

If none of those times work, share 2–3 alternatives and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks,

We'll want to review caching options and whether prefix caching can be used for our workflows.
